correctness.rationale: When every polygon side is occupied, each unsampled corner removes exactly a triangle of area c_j U_j V_j with c_j=sin(theta_j)/2; event complement is ≤m exp(-N ell_min/L). Pairwise survival (1-(u+v)/L)^N on disjoint incident side segments yields exact corner-product expectation with L²/[(N+1)(N+2)] and exponentially small side corrections. Independently verified that survival integration for N=3,4,7,12. The 2m disjoint shrinking boundary germs give independent Exp(1) rescaled gaps, and uniform exponential tails yield convergence of all fixed moments. Integrating exp(-u-z/u) and Laplace saddle give product tail sqrt(pi) z^1/4 exp(-2sqrt z), and finite-sum subexponentiality gives k* dominant-corner factor. Permutation averaging and strict Jensen prove mean-normalized convex order equality iff all sin(theta_j) equal; sine concavity at fixed sum interior angles proves leading mean maximum iff equiangular.
